draft:
**Design system (carried over):** Palette shifts from forest green to tidepool tones — deep teal base, seafoam panel bands, sand-white background, coral accents retained. Headlines in a warm serif, body in a humanist sans, monospace reserved for quotes. Hand-drawn line-art illustrations with subtle water motifs throughout.

1. **Persistent week-rail (left edge)** — Vertical Mon–Sun spine with circular nodes; today glows coral, past days muted, small dots mark teammate activity. Sticky on desktop, collapses to a horizontal dot-row on mobile. Doubles as navigation and an implicit product demo.

2. **Hero** — Two columns: headline left, product screenshot right showing a partially filled team week-grid. Headline mirrors the reference's long conversational cadence: *"Bring every member of your team together around one living plan that updates the moment anything shifts, remembers how long work actually takes, and quietly takes the dread out of Monday morning so nobody ever drops the ball again."* Coral CTA: "Plan this week." A hand-drawn arrow curls from headline to screenshot like a wave.

3. **Logo strip** — Single row of sand-toned grayscale logos (studios, agencies, startups). Understated, no metrics.

4. **Feature trio** — Three equal cards: "Drop work onto days" (drag-and-drop), "See the week at a glance" (filter by person), "Check in async" (comments per task). Verb-first copy, one-line captions, line-art icons with coral fill accents.

5. **Monospace pull quote** — Full-width seafoam band, oversized coral quotation mark. Quote in mono: *"Our Monday standup went from half an hour to a screenshot."* — name, role, small avatar.

6. **How it works** — Three horizontal steps reusing the rail motif: Draft on Friday → Share Monday morning → Adjust as the week moves. Each with a cropped UI fragment.

7. **Closing CTA** — Deep teal band, white serif headline: *"Make next week the calm one."* Email capture, coral button, small tide-chart doodle.

8. **Footer** — Minimal link columns, mono legal line, tiny animated tide mark.
final:
**Key revisions:** the hero headline is now native to Tidepool instead of a word-swap of the shopping list; the week-rail gets an actual functional job; the feature trio became a sharper "what it replaces" section; added objection-handling and concrete microcopy throughout.

1. **Week-rail (sticky, left edge)** — Mon–Sun spine; today's node pulses coral, past days fill like rising tide levels, hover previews each day's workload. Doubles as scroll-nav (active section lights its node). Horizontal dots on mobile. It now *demonstrates* the product instead of just decorating.

2. **Hero** — 60/40 split. Serif headline (Fraunces): *"Bring everyone on your team around one living plan that updates the second anyone moves work, remembers how long things actually take, and quietly takes the status meeting out of Monday so nobody has to ask what you're working on again."* Coral CTA "Plan this week free," mono microcopy "Free up to 10 people." The hand-drawn arrow now points at a *specific detail* in the screenshot with handwritten caption: "← Mara moved this at 7:42am. Everyone saw."

3. **Logo strip** — Sand-toned grayscale studios/agencies; one line: "Small teams who hate status meetings."

4. **What Tidepool replaces** — Three contrast cards (stronger than generic features): *The Monday standup* → async check-ins. *The "quick sync?" ping* → one shared week. *The heavyweight PM tool* → everything on one screen. Line-art icons with coral strikethroughs.

5. **Monospace pull quote** — Full-bleed seafoam band, oversized coral quote mark: *"Our standup went from thirty minutes to a screenshot."* Name, role, avatar, plus two small supporting quotes beneath.

6. **How it works** — Three steps riding the rail motif: *Friday:* draft next week. *Monday:* everyone opens the same page. *All week:* drag, comment, adjust — no meeting. Cropped UI fragments, sand backgrounds.

7. **"Small by design" band** — Objection handling in one line: teams of 2–25, $8/person, no feature maze. Serif, generous whitespace.

8. **Closing CTA** — Deep teal band, white serif: *"Make next week the calm one."* Email capture, coral button, animated tide-line doodle.

9. **Footer** — Minimal links, mono legal line, tiny tide mark.
